prompt-clipboard.name: Prompt Clipboard
prompt-clipboard.tagline: Save, organize, and auto-expand prompts and snippets on any webpage with simple commands
prompt-clipboard.description: A Chrome extension that lets you save, organize, and search prompts and snippets, copy them with one click, or auto-expand them on web pages by typing commands (e.g., /greeting).
features: Organize by categories with fast search
Type /command in any input field to auto-expand
Works on Gmail, Slack, ChatGPT, and any website
howToUse: Open side panel and add prompts
Type /greeting on any webpage to auto-expand
prompt-clipboard.privacy: All data is stored in your browser and never sent to external servers.
prompt-clipboard.supportedLanguages: Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Korean, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese, Indonesian

extension-switch.name: Extension Switch
extension-switch.tagline: Manage installed extensions with groups, toggle ON/OFF, and auto-switch by URL
extension-switch.description: A Chrome extension manager that lets you organize installed extensions into groups, toggle them ON/OFF with one click, and automatically enable/disable them based on the current URL.
howToUse: Toggle ON/OFF by group or individually
extension-switch.privacy: Only extension management data is stored locally in your browser. No external communication.
extension-switch.supportedLanguages: Japanese, English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Arabic, Korean, Thai
